description: The true path of the miniature: a telegram signed M., handed in at Leeds at four; the wife at the fête in the narrator's sight, the partner on the train to Leeds; the telegram then read as the partner's, and the one key drawn that night.

moves.why: Whoever sent it was at the Leeds office at four.
Mrs. Holt was beside me at the fête all that time.
She could not have been in Leeds at four.
Mr. Grove went to Leeds that afternoon.

moves.see: a meeting he meant to keep
moves.why: Read as his, the telegram is Mr. Grove asking Holt to meet him at the mill at ten.

moves.see: one key was drawn that evening
moves.why: And his was the one key drawn that night.
